title: Install
text: OncoProflingTools (OPT) currently available GitHub repository active development. future, plan make available CRAN Bioconductor. Ensure R version 4.0 greater installed. install OPT, run following command R console:
code: install.packages("pak") # alternatively, use native R package manager pak::pkg_install("TYCGenomicsLab/OncoProfilingTools") # will fetch from GitHub library(OncoProfilingTools)

title: Install
text: highly recommended also install load dplyr, MultiAssayExperiment, SummarizedExperiment make use full functionality OPT. install packages, run: Pak automatically install dependencies required OPT. recieve issues missing packages, please install manually.
code: # pak will automatically know to use CRAN or Bioconductor pak::pkg_install(c("dplyr", "MultiAssayExperiment", "SummarizedExperiment")) library("dplyr") library("MultiAssayExperiment") library("SummarizedExperiment")

title: Compare drug sensitivities between two OncoExperiment groups — compare_drug_sensitivities,OncoExperiment-method
text: **User expected define groups prior calling method.** example, compare drug sensitivities two cancer types, subset `OncoExperiment` assign groups: `COAD$group <- c(1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, ...)` Whatever labels chosen groups must passed function. method looks top-level `$group` column compares selected values within PRISM assay. method expects loadable `DrugResponseAssay` (typically named "PRISM") assay data named "response". sign convention : `mean_diff = mean(group1) - mean(group2)`. Negative values indicate lower average response `group1`.
